spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (READY: Subscribe with unhealthy capture -> Error(501, retryable=true); no state change)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (error response classes: 501 is a non-fatal instance)
description: Subscribe while the Endpoint capture is unhealthy/absent: non-fatal Error(501, retryable=true) — connection kept, state stays READY; the Client may retry after the next ConfigurationPublished.
preconditions: Session READY (authenticated, negotiated, configuration published); NOT subscribed.
The Endpoint capture is absent or failed.

steps.note: Non-fatal: NO paired Close; state unchanged (READY).

assertions: Status: code 501, retryable=true, requires_repairing=false (§6.2 defaults; the flag governs Client retry policy independently of fatality).
No Close: 501-on-Subscribe is one of the two v2.0 non-fatal Error instances (the other being duplicate-Subscribe 402) — spec §5.2 error classes.
Client policy (spec §5.3/§6.3): surface; MAY retry after the next ConfigurationPublished.
